properties.site-address: Oxford Rail Station & Becket Street Car Park, Becket Street, Oxford
properties.notes: This site is the subject of a station masterplan SPD published in 2014, however it did not identify a residenital capacity. The Site is also allocated in the emerging Local Plan 2036 which is currently undergoing an examination in public (consultation on proposed modifications following hearings). The Local Plan identifies a minimum of 20 homes to be delivered on this site.
